question: Measured: `git rev-parse v1.4.1^{commit}` is corrupted in PowerShell because ^ is the escape character. Target: a lint that flags unquoted ^ in any ref passed from PowerShell, plus the sanctioned alternative (`git rev-list -n 1 <tag>` or a single-quoted ref) proven equivalent.
title: PowerShell caret escaping mangles git refs

scope.implemented: PowerShell git-caret lint with quote/comment awareness, plus a live annotated-tag peel proving git rev-list -n 1 <tag> and a quoted peel resolve to the same commit in bash and pwsh.
does_not_claim: Windows PowerShell 5.1 or cmd.exe wrapping was executed (this box is Linux)
rules/common/windows-shell.md exists at repo root (only fixture census copies do)
a second human Windows-platform specialist re-ran the probes
scope.proof_surface: shipped lint on fixture .ps1 files (use vs mention); live git in a throwaway annotated-tag repo; live pwsh 7 unquoted vs quoted when present

live_peel.pwsh_unquoted_stderr_tail:
fatal: ambiguous argument 'YwBvAG0AbQBpAHQA': unknown revision or path not in the working tree.
Use '--' to separate paths from revisions, like this:
'git <command> [<revision>...] -- [<file>...]'
live_peel.measured_mechanism: On this box pwsh 7 parses unquoted v1.4.1^{commit} as argv v1.4.1^ plus a scriptblock {commit}; git then errors. cmd.exe caret-unescape (v1.4.1{commit}) also fails against the same repo. Quoted peel and git rev-list -n 1 v1.4.1 return the peeled commit.

tests.output_tail: unquoted peel and HEAD^ flagged; quoted peel, rev-list, and comment mention silent; naive caret grep fires on mention

negative_controls.description: A comment that names git rev-parse v1.4.1^{commit} must not satisfy the lint; a naive '^' substring check does.
Unquoted pwsh peel / leftover argv v1.4.1^ does not return the commit; quoted peel and rev-list do, and the annotated tag object SHA differs from that commit.

evidence.claim: Unquoted git peel refs from PowerShell are flagged by the lint; quoted peels, rev-list, and comment mentions are not.
On this box, unquoted git rev-parse v1.4.1^{commit} under pwsh does not return the peeled commit, while git rev-list -n 1 v1.4.1 and a single-quoted peel do, matching bash.

reviewer.notes: Probe 1 re-runs the lint on fixtures without trusting this file's self-report. Probe 2 rebuilds a fresh annotated-tag repo and re-runs bash plus pwsh (when present).

manifest_registration.note: per-unit only; global unit_manifest.py --write was not run

residual_unknowns.claim: Windows PowerShell 5.1 reconstructing a cmd.exe command line was not executed here. cmd.exe caret-unescape was applied as argv to real git (v1.4.1{commit}) and failed, but that is not a Windows console host.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-run probe2_corrected_form_equivalent.py under Windows PowerShell 5.1 and Git Bash and diff argv/SHA against this receipt.

downstream_consumers.note: measure runs after this emit; probes re-run live
